Questions

Frequently asked

Still not sure? Call 506-847-7627 or send us a message.

Memberships Before you come At the wash Payment

Memberships

How often can I wash with a membership?

Once a day, every day, at the level you signed up for. Members can also use the vacuums once a day, even on days they don't wash.

Can someone else drive my car through?

Yes. A membership belongs to the vehicle, not the person, so anyone driving the tagged vehicle can use it.

Can one membership cover more than one vehicle?

No. Each membership covers one vehicle, and its tag stays on that vehicle's windshield. For a second vehicle, add a second membership, or pay for a single wash when you bring it in.

What if I get a new windshield, or my tag gets peeled off or damaged?

Come into the office at Wash 66 and we'll be more than happy to get you a new tag. Tags stop working once they're peeled off, so an old tag can't be moved over. If you're getting a new windshield, come by once it's in.

How do I cancel or change my membership?

Come see us at the wash. Membership changes are made on site, not by phone or email. Cancelling needs at least 20 days' notice before your billing date, or you may be charged for one more month.

What happens if my card is declined?

If a payment still hasn't gone through after 30 days, your membership is suspended until you update your card details at the wash. Memberships bill automatically each month, so please keep your card details up to date.

Before you come

What are your holiday hours?

We're open 10 am to 6 pm on holidays and closed Christmas Day.

Is the wash ever closed during regular hours?

Once in a while. We may close because of bad weather or for equipment maintenance. We post updates on Facebook when we can, or you can call 506-847-7627 before you head over.

Can any vehicle go through?

Most cars, SUVs and pickups fit. The clearance at the entrance is 7'2" (2.18 m), so if you have a roof box, a cargo or bike rack on top, or a very tall lifted truck, check your height before you pull in or ask the attendant. Very low or lowered cars can scrape getting onto the track, so if yours sits low, ask the attendant first. We also can't take vehicles caked in mud from off-roading, trucks with loose debris in the bed, or anything with loose or damaged parts. Call us if you're not sure.

Do I need to clear off snow and ice first?

Yes, please. Brush the snow off, roof included, and clear away any ice before you pull in. Packed snow and chunks of ice can damage the equipment and your vehicle, so clearing them is up to the driver.

At the wash

How long does a wash take?

Usually about two minutes through the tunnel. Right after a snowstorm there can be a short line, since everyone has the same idea.

Do I stay in my car?

Yes. Once the attendant has you lined up on the track, shift into neutral, take your hands off the wheel and keep your foot off the brake. Braking can knock the conveyor chain off its track, which shuts the wash down for everyone behind you.

Is it a touchless wash?

No, it's a soft-touch wash. After the pre-soak, soft brushes do the scrubbing, which is what lifts the road film that water pressure alone tends to leave behind.

Can you spray off bugs before the wash?

Usually, yes. Just ask the attendant at the entrance. It's a free courtesy, not part of any wash or membership, and sometimes we can't offer it because we're out of bug spray or the pressure washer is down. For safety, attendants don't cross the track, so they can't spray the passenger side.

Do the vacuums cost extra?

No, not with a wash. Vacuums are free with any wash and with every membership. If you only want to vacuum, it's $5.

I vacuumed up something important. Can you get it back?

Maybe. Each vacuum has a trap near the top that catches some items, so ask an attendant and we'll happily check it. If it isn't in the trap, we can't get it back, because for safety staff aren't allowed to open the vacuum canisters or reach inside. Before you vacuum, it's worth checking the floor and seats for anything valuable.

Payment, gift cards and detailing

How can I pay?

We take all major credit cards, including Visa, Mastercard and American Express, plus Apple Pay and cash. Cash works for everything except a monthly membership, which bills automatically to a credit card.

Do your prices include tax?

Single wash prices include HST. Monthly memberships, prepay deals and detailing are plus HST.

How do I request a refund?

Come in and talk to an attendant at the wash. Approved refunds are paid in cash or by e-transfer, or applied as credit toward your current or a future membership. Refunds can take 5 to 7 business days.

Do you sell gift cards?

Yes. Pick one up at the wash and load it with any amount, or get bonus value: a $60 gift card for $50, or a $125 gift card for $100. Gift cards can be used for washes, memberships and detailing, you can add more value to the same card any time, and you can check the balance at worldgiftcard.com.

Do you offer fleet rates?

Yes. Contact us with the number and type of vehicles and we'll put together a rate.

Do I need an appointment for detailing?

Please book ahead. Detailing depends on staff availability, and booking makes sure we have the time set aside for your vehicle.
